versions.changelog:
Summary: Major update simplifies the skill to focus on browser-based checklist-driven content reviews, removing automated scripts and technical crawling.

- Removes all script files and advanced technical audit tooling.
- Updates the description to reflect a conversational, browser-based SEO review process.
- Provides new example prompts, clear checklist-style recommendations, and progress tracking guidance.
- Limits functionality to analysis of visible page content only (no crawling, API calls, or deep server checks).
- Tailors the skill for website owners and small businesses seeking user-friendly SEO improvement advice.

- Metadata in SKILL.md updated: removed the homepage URL field.
- Version updated to 1.0.1.
- Minor content or formatting adjustments in documentation files.
- No functional or CLI changes to audit, check, or report scripts.

- Initial release of GTS_seo-audit-optimizer: a comprehensive toolkit for running full site-wide SEO audits and analyzing on-page and technical SEO factors.
- Provides actionable optimization recommendations and tracks SEO improvements over time.
- Includes scripts for core audit, reporting, and quick checks on individual SEO elements (titles, meta tags, headers, speed, mobile).
- Features user-friendly report formats for quick summaries and detailed breakdowns.
- Designed for website owners, bloggers, small businesses, and digital marketers seeking professional-level SEO insights.
